Type: table
Name: Strathwood St. Croix Aluminum Rectangular Dining Table
All-weather, rectangular dining table with umbrella hole in the center Made of durable, lightweight, rust-resistant cast aluminum in white Wide ribs give smooth, even surface and allow rain to fall through and dry out Matching chairs sold separately; part of coordinating St. Croix furniture collection Table measures 59 inches wide by 38 inches deep by 28-1/2 inches high; easy assembly
